history.summary: NOTE: this CSV row describes the same site as row 176 (Mahadev Ghat Temple) - the temple stands at Mahadev Ghat on the Kharun River and is the ghat's centrepiece. Built in 1402 by Hajiraj Naik during the rule of Brahmadeo Rai, son of Kalachuri king Ramachandra; Brahmadeo Rai's monumental Sanskrit inscription is preserved at the Mahant Ghasidas Memorial Museum. Nagara-style sandstone temple with carved exteriors depicting the navagrahas, guardian deities and Ramayana/Mahabharata scenes; a protected monument under the Archaeological Survey of India. Devotees report an akhand dhuni said to have burned for 500+ years. Hatkeshwar is the family deity of the Nagar Brahmin community; the older, Skanda-Purana-referenced Hatkeshwar is at Vadnagar in Gujarat. Opening hours conflict: pilgrim listings say 6 AM-8 PM while Justdial lists 6 AM-1 PM (verify on visit). Coordinates below are from a place listing and are approximate.

town_description: Raipur is the capital of Chhattisgarh, a city rich in medieval heritage located on the banks of the Kharun River. Mahadev Ghat lies in the Raipura area of the city, about 5 km from the centre, and is one of its oldest pilgrimage spots.
